name: Release Watch
author: Poni
description: Watches the npm, PyPI and Homebrew packages and GitHub repositories you depend on and notifies you when a new version is out.

settings.label: Notify when a new version is out
Show new versions beside the notch until you open them
GitHub token (optional)
settings.help: Without a token GitHub allows 60 checks an hour, which is plenty for a few repositories. A fine-grained token with no extra permissions raises the limit. Saved in Poni's settings on this Mac and only sent to api.github.com.

id.name: Pantau Rilis
id.description: Memantau paket npm, PyPI dan Homebrew serta repositori GitHub yang Anda pakai, dan memberi tahu saat ada versi baru.

notify.label: Beri tahu saat ada versi baru

beside.label: Tampilkan versi baru di samping notch sampai Anda membukanya

token.label: Token GitHub (opsional)
token.help: Tanpa token GitHub mengizinkan 60 pengecekan per jam, cukup untuk beberapa repositori. Token fine-grained tanpa izin tambahan menaikkan batasnya. Disimpan di pengaturan Poni di Mac ini dan hanya dikirim ke api.github.com.
